question.text: Which of the following matters is NOT dealt with by SEBI under the SCORES mechanism?

answer.text: Complaints against stockbrokers registered with SEBI
Complaints related to the SEBI Act violations
Complaints against companies that have been wound up
Complaints under Section 26 of the Companies Act

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook lists complaints against unlisted, delisted, wound up, liquidated, or sick companies among the categories of complaints that are NOT dealt with by SEBI under SCORES. A complaint against a wound-up company therefore falls outside the SCORES mechanism. The Trap: Complaints under the SEBI Act and complaints under Section 26 of the Companies Act are within the scope of matters that SEBI does deal with under SCORES, so they are not the correct "NOT" answer. Note: The not-dealt-with list also includes unlisted, delisted, liquidated, and sick companies — the wound-up category is one of several status-based exclusions.
